rows.text:
Dear {M#Mr.}{F#Miss} [Trailblazer],

Apologies. Farewell. Emergency call. Support needed. Troupe mobilizing.
Sorry. We couldn't properly welcome {TEXTJOIN#247}. Was our enthusiasm too much? Our sincerest apologies.
Best wishes to {TEXTJOIN#247} and {TEXTJOIN#247}'s parent.
On your next journey, stop by. We insist.

With regards, Troupe Leader "Behemoth," scribed by "Beast King"
